Makara.remedy: Pour water at the base of a Peepal tree without touching it on Sunday, or simply pray for peace of ancestors.

Kumbha.summary: Transiting Moon in your 3rd house enhances your courage, persuasive communication, and initiative.
Kumbha.general: You possess the dynamism to bridge gaps, initiate constructive dialogues, and pursue short, joyful travel plans.
Kumbha.career: Marketing, media, writing, and communication ventures flourish. Your proactive suggestions earn widespread agreement.
Kumbha.finance: Financial gains via communication skills, freelancing, or past efforts are indicated. Keep transaction receipts tidy.
Kumbha.relationships: Cherished interactions with siblings, cousins, or neighbors reinforce warmth and mutual companionship.
Kumbha.health: Physical endurance is high. Keep shoulders and upper back relaxed through periodic stretches.
Kumbha.remedy: Feed birds with mixed grains in the morning and offer respects to your elders.

Meena.summary: Moon in the 2nd house accentuates wealth, delightful speech, family unity, and nourishment.
Meena.general: A harmonious day filled with melodious speech, sumptuous family dining, and appreciation of your material blessings.
Meena.career: Diplomatic words unlock doors. Your ability to negotiate agreements graciously leaves a lasting, positive impression.
Meena.finance: Favorable day for reviewing savings and wealth accumulation strategies. Financial confidence remains robust.
Meena.relationships: Delightful family gatherings cultivate shared happiness. Expressing appreciation deepens marital harmony.
Meena.health: Enjoy wholesome, sattvic food and protect your throat by avoiding overly chilled beverages.
Meena.remedy: Prepare kheer in the evening and keep it under the moonlit sky for Sharad Purnima blessings before consuming as prasad.
